display.purpose: Names the computation at the top of the audit sheet.

title.purpose: Introduces compact evidence sections such as Full-run summary and Caveats.

body.purpose: Carries notes, lists, table values, and supporting explanation.

data-compact.purpose: Carries summary values after the narrow-screen table reflow.

code.purpose: Identifies draw-selection methods and source hashes.

components.css: .ds-artifact-header { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-artifact-header h1 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-artifact-header p { max-width: 72ch; margin: 0 0 28px; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Plot Frame
components.description: The ruled, width-dominant frame that contains an interactive Bokeh chart.
components.css: .ds-plot-frame { min-height: 460px; padding: 20px 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-plot-frame { min-height: 390px; } }

components.name: Full-run Summary Table
components.description: An exact numerical summary that becomes self-labeled vertical records on narrow screens.
components.css: .ds-table-scroll { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-summary-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-summary-table th, .ds-summary-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); text-align: right; } .ds-summary-table th:first-child { text-align: left; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-summary-table, .ds-summary-table thead, .ds-summary-table tbody, .ds-summary-table tr, .ds-summary-table th, .ds-summary-table td { display: block; width: 100%; } .ds-summary-table thead { display: none; } .ds-summary-table tr { padding: 8px 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-summary-table th, .ds-summary-table td { padding: 5px 4px; border: 0; text-align: left; } .ds-summary-table th[scope="row"] { padding-bottom: 7px; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-summary-table td { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(116px, 40%) 1fr; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.88rem; } .ds-summary-table td::before { content: attr(data-label); color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; } }

components.name: Draw Coverage Note
components.description: A muted statement of retained draws, population draws, and selection method.
components.css: .ds-draw-coverage-note { max-width: 72ch; color: var(--muted); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-draw-coverage-note code { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; }

components.name: Provenance List
components.description: A visible record of runtime versions and the source SHA-256 for each result.
components.css: .ds-provenance-list { color: var(--ink); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-provenance-list code { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
Each visualization reads as the audit sheet for one computation. Warm paper, dark ink, thin rules, and a single cobalt data color give the chart enough visual authority without competing with the numerical result.

The document shell stays editorial and restrained. It puts the quantity and unit first, gives most of the width to the chart, then keeps full-run summaries, retained-draw coverage, provenance, resource requirements, and calibration limits in the same reading path.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and dark ink establish a quiet reading surface.
Cobalt identifies data and focus without encoding rank.
Serif headings separate interpretation from working detail.
Tabular numbers and thin rules keep summaries easy to compare.
Responsive records preserve every label and value without horizontal clipping.
dos: **Do** keep the quantity and unit immediately above a width-dominant chart.
**Do** keep full-run statistics, retained-draw coverage, provenance, resource requirements, and calibration limits visible around the chart.
**Do** use cobalt for statistical marks and keyboard focus, with tabular figures for comparable numbers.
**Do** reflow summary rows into labeled records at the 640px threshold.
**Do** preserve raw source values in hover details and recognizable Bokeh controls.
donts: **Don't** use color to imply scenario rank or create decorative categories.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients, paper texture, ornamental composition, or an oversized numeral to the audit sheet.
**Don't** hide source hashes, subset limits, resource requirements, or calibration caveats behind interaction.
**Don't** depend on horizontal clipping to expose a summary value on narrow screens.
**Don't** reuse the plot's statistical marks as decorative interface motifs.
